title: spermacoce arvensis
intro: Spermacoce arvensis, commonly known as Buttonweed or Scabious, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Spermacoce arvensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antifungal, and anti-bacterial activities. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
